sampling.group_rule: Choose ETF with probability4/26 and stock with probability22/26, independent of history/outcomes; then sample each group from a seeded shuffled episode deck without replacement until exhausted; uniformly choose a full512-transition window
sampling.episode_cycle: Shuffle each group again only after every member was drawn; no return/regime ranking
sampling.actual_logging: Per-symbol starts/transitions, group starts/transitions, dataset and normalization identities; report actual ETF mass, not just intended probability
sampling.budget_justification: Same expanded111 dataset in both arms,100k for full symbol transition coverage; fixed budget, not an extension of completed diversity study

name: recurrent-cash-choice-2026-10-22
hypothesis: A learned explicit cash category can reduce harmful compulsory exposure. Compare ternary direction against a matched binary categorical control, an aligned Gaussian sign control and the strongest posthoc Gaussian unit control. Distribution and cash availability effects are separate contrasts; no claim that cash caused the prior failure.
selection_metric: Unchanged equal-weight mean validation net return; selected/final separately reported, actual100k final post-update required

screen_gate.failure: Close fixed cash-choice family after failed seed11 gates; no extra steps, cash thresholds, entropy/architecture grids or promotion. Preserve all negative results.

confirmation_gate.interpretation: Development gates only; a frozen prospective comparison remains required

constraints.data: Expanded111-tradable source preserves all original episodes exactly; derived expanded payload replaces only preprocessing with original immutable normalizer and records lineage. Additional85 symbols contribute training only. Original26-symbol development episodes stay exact.
constraints.causality: Only current completed market data and actual held execution state. Full-period losing-stock labels reporting only, never inputs/sampling/rewards/checkpoint selection
constraints.simulation: Unchanged four-component actions,100k equity, whole shares, exposure cap1,20-session holding limit, next-session fills, costs and corporate actions
constraints.splits: Train through2020, repeated development2021-2023 only; never open/evaluate2024-September2026
constraints.short_side: Reconcile every new run's long/short costs and marked P&L. Report joint positive total return AND positive net short P&L on declining stocks; never loss reduction alone
constraints.limitations: Survivor stocks, revised Yahoo history, correlated development episodes; no live/paper broker orders
constraints.checkpoint_identity: Current checkpoint/report/model/settings/tensor identities required. Explicit distribution/cash availability metadata and protection/exposure trace support validation, selection and frozen inference. No final-test selection.
constraints.observations: All arms identical masked21 input contract: seven market, five legacy account fields, nine execution zeros. Actual modified-path portfolio and recurrent state are carried causally.
constraints.initialization: Binary and ternary share identical seeded tensors, six-output head and three Gaussian deviations. Binary omits cash logit from likelihood/sample support. Gaussian controls share identical initial tensors with one another; cross-family tensor equality is neither possible nor claimed. Record parameter counts and actual hashes.
constraints.memory: Same separate one-layer64 LSTMs and masked21 inputs. Carry actual recurrent state and reset at episodes. Actual sampled actions/log probabilities, gradient updates, save/load and frozen sequence parity required.
constraints.comparison: Four fresh100k runs, fixed source/data/sampling/seed/optimizer/rollout. All actual sampling counts must match. Cash contrasts binary; binary contrasts aligned Gaussian; strongest posthoc Gaussian prevents a weak-control promotion. No shared final-weight equality expected because execution paths differ.
constraints.rollout: 1000 rollout transitions, batch50, ten epochs in all screen arms, actual100k steps. Standard library recurrent minibatch sequence boundaries/masks; no BPTT length tuning. Smoke128 rollout, batch64,512 actual steps.
constraints.action: Output signed exposure is categorical -1/+1 in binary or -1/0/+1 in cash. Learned stop/near/width use independent Gaussian outputs with standard SB3 clipping. Joint categorical plus Gaussian log likelihood and summed entropy; no sign transform of a learned Gaussian direction in hybrid arms. Cash request still follows normal next-session and protective preemption rules; no immediate-fill promise.

execution.cleanup: Retain all models/checkpoints/curves; verify publication checksums before removing duplicates; verify every owned session stopped
